item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-ae39bbc07f46d222","start_unit":13,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"In late July 2023, police reportedly used rubber bullets, tear gas, water cannons, and batons against opposition protesters; authorities arrested over 800 BNP leaders and activists, filed cases against more than 1,500 named and 15,000 unnamed opposition figures, and used open cases and raids to intimidate opponents. Leaked police-meeting minutes allegedly described systematic arrests and convictions intended to disqualify opposition members from the election.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns July 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes conduct to Bangladesh authorities and the ruling Awami League government under Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina; direct personal authorization is not established in these units.","limitations":["Accounts include allegations and police statements; the source does not establish Sheikh Hasina's personal involvement in each incident."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae39bbc07f46d222","start_unit":15,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"Police reportedly checked phones and interrogated people entering Dhaka, while some arrest charges appeared baseless, including a case naming two people who had died months earlier. The government publicly renewed commitments to free and fair elections while authorities were simultaneously repressing opposition activists.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns 2023 pre-election events and official statements.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the conduct to authorities and reports the public commitment by a state minister; it does not prove Sheikh Hasina personally made or knew each claim.","limitations":["The document reports alleged abuses and does not provide a judicial finding on the individual cases."]},{"source_id":"SRC-58ea88683542112f","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"An OHCHR special-procedures summary records information received concerning widespread repression against civil society, human rights defenders, journalists, and political activists in Bangladesh from October 2023 through January 2024, before and during the 7 January 2024 election.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Partly fits 2023 because the stated period begins in October 2023; it also extends into January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The summary concerns Bangladesh authorities but does not identify Sheikh Hasina's personal acts or provide detailed incident findings.","limitations":["The supplied summary contains no identified victims or substantive allegation details."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2956d21c5e5c472a","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"An OHCHR special-procedures communication dated 20 February 2023 records information concerning the ongoing prosecution of investigative journalist Rozina Islam, under mandates covering freedom of expression, human rights defenders, judicial independence, and violence against women and girls.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly dated February 2023, though the prosecution originated earlier.","ruler_attribution":"The communication concerns Bangladeshi authorities; the supplied record does not establish Sheikh Hasina's personal direction or the merits of the prosecution.","limitations":["Only the communication summary is supplied, without the underlying allegations or government reply."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0017750455fdc7c0","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"An OHCHR communication dated 5 June 2023 records information about the reported risk of imminent repatriation of approximately 6,000 Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh to Myanmar, under mandates including arbitrary detention, human rights defenders, internally displaced persons, poverty, religion or belief, and transitional justice.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.3","6B.6","6B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly dated June 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The record concerns the Bangladesh government's treatment and proposed repatriation of Rohingya refugees but does not identify Sheikh Hasina's personal decision-making role.","limitations":["The supplied search result gives only a summary of reported risk, not the underlying communication or outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0e0b7bc47623a60b","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The UN records that Sheikh Hasina, as Bangladesh's head of government, addressed the 78th General Assembly on 22 September 2023; the supplied page identifies the event and speaker but does not provide the speech text or substantive policy claims.","question_ids":["8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly dated September 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Directly identifies Sheikh Hasina as speaker and head of government.","limitations":["The supplied document contains metadata and a summary heading only, not enough substantive content to establish a concrete policy position or implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-531f1aa531e2b9a4","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In August 2023, Amnesty International stated that Bangladesh's draft Cyber Security Act would repeal the Digital Security Act but, in its preliminary assessment, retained repressive provisions that had been used to threaten and restrict freedom of expression.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.6","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly dated August 2023 and concerns a proposed 2023 law.","ruler_attribution":"The document addresses the Bangladeshi government's draft legislation; it does not establish Sheikh Hasina's personal drafting or approval role.","limitations":["The supplied text gives Amnesty's preliminary assessment, not the final enacted law or later implementation evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4fb539a113855581","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"CIVICUS reported that Bangladesh's civic-space rating was downgraded to 'closed' in December 2023 because of a pre-election crackdown involving intimidation, violence, arrests, torture, fabricated charges against opposition members, attacks on protesters, targeting of journalists and human rights defenders, and retention of repressive language in the Cyber Security Act.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.6","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns conditions during 2023 and the run-up to the January 2024 election.","ruler_attribution":"CIVICUS attributes the crackdown to the government and refers to the Sheikh Hasina regime; the supplied passage does not establish each act as personally directed by her.","limitations":["The rating synthesizes CIVICUS's sources and expert assessment; the passage does not provide incident-level adjudication."]},{"source_id":"SRC-abef586deb0f41fb","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"An ILO project launched on 1 May 2023 with the Bangladesh government, workers' and employers' organizations, and international partners aims to advance labour reforms and decent work through stronger labour laws, labour administration, social dialogue, safer and more inclusive enterprises, and child-labour reduction, with implementation scheduled through June 2028.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.6","5B.8","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.4","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Begins in May 2023 but is a multi-year project extending beyond 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The ILO identifies the Government of Bangladesh as a project partner; it does not attribute individual decisions to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The document describes project aims and planned outcomes, not verified 2023 execution or achieved results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6c0737a25d4ce7d0","start_unit":9,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"On 27 December 2023, WFP and the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics launched a memorandum of understanding to strengthen official statistics for food security and SDG monitoring, including poverty and undernutrition mapping, food-security surveys, shock-responsive social-protection research, and evidence for the forthcoming Ninth Five-Year Plan.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.6","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The agreement concerns Bangladesh government institutions, especially BBS; Sheikh Hasina is not named as personally directing it.","limitations":["The document establishes a partnership and planned evidence activities, not completed welfare outcomes or direct prime-ministerial control."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-f3c9ef197a1b96d6","SRC-7042e3821c6e2829","SRC-b5dbd5010e26eaf1"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied corpus is uneven: several documents are summaries or metadata rather than full underlying records.","Many facts concern Bangladesh authorities or government institutions and do not establish Sheikh Hasina's personal knowledge, authorization, or control.","The 2023-2023 period limits use of documents whose substantive content concerns earlier years or extends into 2024."]}
